content.comment_body: Hello. My sibling changed the password for the [article_no] [product_name] and has forgotten it. The device is currently in OP mode and I am unable to return to ADMIN mode. I've tried several potential passwords without success. I connected the device to a PC and attempted to remove the program and password using [product_name] software, then tried the default password 'logo', but no luck. My sibling has put me in a difficult situation. I'm stuck, please help.
Under 'Tools > Transfer > Access Control,' enter the password for access using [product_name] and [product_name] operator panel. Please see the attachment.
Thank you. I tried following your instructions with the default password 'logo', but the device still displays 'Invalid password.' What should I do next?
My primary language is German, so I can only provide a screenshot in German. Did you press the 'Apply' button after entering the new password twice? If not, the new password will not be accepted.
Yes, after validating the button, the device changed from a stopped state to a running state.
I can confirm that this is the correct process. I have just tested it with my [product_name] device and it works.
Thank you. My [product_name] device seems to have some issues. I tried with another device and it worked well. Thank you again.
Answer arrived just in time, but the last activity in this thread was 3 years ago.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are experiencing challenges resetting or recovering the password for the [product_name] controller ([article_no] version) after it's forgotten. Attempts using default passwords and software have not worked, though the process appears successful on other devices. This points to possible device-specific problems, leading to frustration and confusion about password recovery and device access.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect a dependable way to reset or recover passwords and restore ADMIN access to the [product_name] device, ideally through software tools or default credentials.
